profiles.description: Continuous service coverage over time: stand-ready support, maintenance, hosting or access subscription. Recognize prepaid value evenly across inclusive service months.
Point-in-time physical goods delivery: prepaid equipment, merchandise or a finished product. Recognize the full value when goods are delivered and accepted by the customer.

requests.note: Not a continuous hosting subscription or stand-ready maintenance service: this is a prepaid physical server delivered and accepted in November.

limitation: Negation and mixed obligations require human review; this one challenge cannot establish general performance.
